headline: Data Engineer | 5 years experience in Spark, Scala, and AWS data platforms
summary: Data engineer with five years of end-to-end experience building scalable data pipelines on AWS using Apache Spark, Scala, Python, Airflow, and Snowflake. Proven track record of reducing latency, cutting costs, and enabling data-driven decision making for fintech and enterprise clients. Adept at mentoring teams and implementing data quality frameworks.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
highlights: Designed and executed a Spark Structured Streaming pipeline ingesting 2.5 TB/day of clickstream data from Kafka into Snowflake, reducing end-to-end latency from 45 minutes to under 5 minutes.
Migrated 30+ legacy ETL jobs from on-prem Airflow to AWS Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA), cutting operational overhead by 40% and saving approximately ₹1.2 million annually.
Built dbt models that transformed raw transactional data into a unified customer 360 view, enabling PhonePe’s marketing team to increase campaign ROI by 18% year‑over‑year.
Implemented schema evolution checks using Great Expectations, preventing 98% of data quality incidents in production.
Mentored a team of four junior engineers, conducting bi‑weekly code reviews and reducing average PR turnaround time from three days to twelve hours.

experience.title: Data Engineer
highlights: Developed Scala‑based Spark batch jobs processing 1.2 TB of daily transaction logs for a banking client, improving job runtime from 90 minutes to 30 minutes via partition pruning and broadcast joins.
Created Python Airflow DAGs orchestrating data extraction from Oracle, transformation in Spark, and loading into AWS Redshift, achieving 99.5% SLA compliance over 12 months.
Integrated Kafka Connect connectors to stream CDC updates from MySQL to S3, enabling near‑real‑time analytics dashboards used by 150+ business users.
Optimized Snowflake warehouse sizing using query profiling, reducing monthly compute spend by 22% (≈₹850K).
Authored internal documentation and conducted workshops on Scala best practices for a squad of six engineers, increasing code reuse by 35%.
